notes: People: the app finds the faces in your photos, on your computer only, and groups them by person. Name them, merge groups, and click a person to see just their photos
Photos of the same subject: offered as alternatives in a window you can enlarge, with a way to mark the one to use
Select a few photos and press Space to see them large, side by side
Drag a story by its grip in Photos to move it, and its pages move with it
A language setting for the titles Claude writes (English unless you change it), and Claude asks once before switching when you write in another language
P and D switch between Photos and Design
Settings fit without sideways scrolling, with a separate AI tab
More time steps in Photos, a Check for updates now button, and the view keeps your place when you change the photo size, click a photo on a page or zoom
Fixes: moved photos no longer come back as floating guests, alternatives stay one per page, and a spread shared by two stories moves one page at a time
Fixes: Find people now works in the installed apps (3.7.0 was missing a part), and a story's spread layout is redone when its pages move to the other side of the book
